AI inference costs just dropped by up to 90%. Read that again.

Model routing — intelligently sending each AI query to the cheapest model that can handle it — is cutting enterprise inference costs by 60% to 90%. OpenAI separately halved its own costs through internal optimizations. And Chinese labs like DeepSeek are pushing prices even lower with techniques like speculative decoding.

This changes everything about AI economics in production. Most companies are still running single-model architectures, sending every request to their most expensive model. They are overspending by 5x to 10x.

The projects your team shelved because the unit economics did not work at scale? They might work now. The AI applications you assumed were too expensive for production? Re-run the numbers.

The real competitive advantage is no longer who has the best model. It is who has the smartest architecture for deploying the right model at the right cost for every single task.
